name: Software Engineer
description: They write code to build apps, websites, or systems people use every day. They spend time fixing bugs and improving how software works.

name: UX Designer
description: They design how apps and websites feel and look to users. They test ideas to make things easy and enjoyable to use.

name: Data Scientist
description: They study data to find patterns and useful insights. They help companies make better decisions based on numbers.

name: Product Manager
description: They plan what features a product should have and guide teams to build it. They talk to users and teams to make sure the product solves real problems.

name: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: They protect computer systems from hackers and attacks. They monitor systems and fix weaknesses before problems happen.

name: DevOps Engineer
description: They make sure software runs smoothly and updates quickly. They connect development and operations teams to improve systems.

name: Machine Learning Engineer
description: They build systems that learn from data and improve over time. They test models and make sure they work in real situations.

name: Frontend Developer
description: They build the parts of websites and apps that users see and click on. They make sure everything looks good and works smoothly.

name: Backend Developer
description: They build the hidden systems that power apps and websites. They handle data, servers, and how everything connects behind the scenes.

name: Mobile Developer
description: They create apps for phones and tablets. They test apps to make sure they run well on different devices.

name: Architect
description: They design buildings and plan how spaces will be used. They work with clients and engineers to turn ideas into real structures.

name: Civil Engineer
description: They design and build roads, bridges, and other large structures. They make sure projects are safe and strong.

name: Structural Engineer
description: They make sure buildings and structures can stand safely. They calculate loads and choose strong materials.

name: Mechanical Engineer
description: They design machines and moving parts like engines. They test designs to make sure they work properly.

name: Electrical Engineer
description: They work with electrical systems like power and circuits. They design and test systems used in buildings and devices.

name: Urban Planner
description: They plan how cities grow and where buildings and parks go. They try to make places better to live and work.

name: Construction Manager
description: They manage building projects from start to finish. They make sure work is done on time and safely.

name: Quantity Surveyor
description: They track costs and budgets for construction projects. They help make sure money is spent wisely.

name: Surveyor
description: They measure land and map out areas for building. They use tools to gather accurate data on sites.

name: Environmental Engineer
description: They work to protect the environment and reduce pollution. They design systems to clean water and air.

name: Doctor (GP)
description: They see patients with common health problems and give advice or treatment. They help people stay healthy and manage illnesses.

name: Surgeon
description: They perform operations to treat injuries or diseases. They spend long hours in surgery and preparing for procedures.

name: Nurse
description: They care for patients and help doctors during treatment. They check vital signs and support people during recovery.

name: Pharmacist
description: They prepare and give out medicines to patients. They explain how to use medicine safely.

name: Dentist
description: They care for teeth and gums and fix dental problems. They perform cleanings and small procedures.

name: Physiotherapist
description: They help people recover from injuries through exercises. They guide patients to improve movement and strength.

name: Psychologist
description: They help people understand their thoughts and feelings. They talk with clients to improve mental health.

name: Paramedic
description: They respond to emergencies and give first aid. They transport patients safely to hospitals.

name: Radiographer
description: They take medical images like X-rays and scans. They help doctors see inside the body.

name: Veterinarian
description: They treat animals and keep them healthy. They perform checkups and sometimes surgery.

name: Teacher
description: They teach students different subjects in school. They prepare lessons and help students learn.

name: University Lecturer
description: They teach students at a university level. They also do research and write about their subject.

name: School Counsellor
description: They support students with personal or school problems. They listen and give advice to help students cope.

name: Educational Psychologist
description: They help students who struggle with learning. They assess needs and suggest ways to improve learning.

name: Speech Therapist
description: They help people improve speech and communication skills. They work with children and adults with speech issues.

name: Lawyer
description: They give legal advice and represent clients in court. They study laws and prepare cases.

name: Judge
description: They make decisions in court based on the law. They listen to cases and decide outcomes.

name: Paralegal
description: They support lawyers by preparing documents and research. They help organize case information.

name: Compliance Officer
description: They make sure companies follow rules and laws. They check processes and report issues.

name: Patent Attorney
description: They help protect inventions with legal rights. They write and file patent documents.

name: Accountant
description: They manage money records and make sure finances are accurate. They prepare reports and help with budgeting and taxes.

name: Financial Analyst
description: They study financial data to help businesses make decisions. They look at trends and predict future performance.

name: Investment Banker
description: They help companies raise money and manage big financial deals. They work long hours analyzing and negotiating.

name: Actuary
description: They use math to predict risks for insurance and finance. They analyze data to help companies plan for the future.

name: Tax Advisor
description: They help people and businesses manage their taxes. They give advice on how to follow rules and save money.

name: Journalist
description: They research and report news stories. They interview people and write articles or create reports.

name: Copywriter
description: They write text for ads, websites, and marketing materials. They try to make messages clear and interesting.

name: Graphic Designer
description: They create visual designs for brands, ads, and media. They use software to turn ideas into images.

name: Photographer
description: They take photos for events, media, or clients. They edit images to improve quality and style.

name: Filmmaker
description: They create videos or films from idea to final product. They plan scenes, direct shoots, and edit footage.

name: Marketing Manager
description: They plan campaigns to promote products or services. They track results and adjust strategies.

name: PR Specialist
description: They manage how a company is seen by the public. They write press releases and handle media communication.

name: Social Media Manager
description: They run social media accounts for brands or people. They post content and respond to followers.

name: Brand Strategist
description: They shape how a brand looks and feels to customers. They plan long-term messaging and identity.

name: Advertising Creative
description: They come up with ideas for ads and campaigns. They work with teams to bring ideas to life.

name: Chef
description: They cook meals and create new dishes. They manage kitchen work and ensure food quality.

name: Hotel Manager
description: They run the daily operations of a hotel. They make sure guests have a good experience.

name: Event Planner
description: They organize events like weddings or conferences. They handle details like venues, schedules, and vendors.

name: Logistics Manager
description: They manage how goods are stored and moved. They make sure deliveries happen on time.

name: Supply Chain Analyst
description: They study how products move from suppliers to customers. They find ways to make the process faster and cheaper.

name: Operations Associate
description: They support daily business tasks and improve processes. They help teams run smoothly and solve problems.

name: Public Policy
description: They study and create policies that affect communities and governments. They research issues and suggest solutions.
